# Attribution for Chinese Dictionaries

This userscript distributes/uses data from the following open dictionary projects:

## 1. BKRS (Большой китайско-русский словарь)
- **Source:** https://bkrs.info / https://github.com/ukoloff/bkrs
- **License:** Open dictionary collaborative database, available under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 / 4.0.
- **Description:** Direct Chinese to Russian lexical database, providing definitions, pinyin, and parts of speech.

## 2. CC-CEDICT
- **Source:** MDBG Chinese-English Dictionary (https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary?page=cc-cedict)
- **License:** Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0).
- **Description:** Community-maintained Chinese to English dictionary with traditional/simplified variants and pinyin.
